title: Zack Polanski will not say sorry to Farage for sharing guillotine image
summary_full: Green party leader says post was ‘inadvertent mistake’ after Reform UK accuses him of ‘inciting murder’The Green party leader, Zack Polanski, has said he made an “inadvertent mistake” by sharing an Instagram post of a man wearing a T-shirt featuring an image of a guillotine and the phrase “we’re only making plans for Nigel”, but he repeatedly said he would not apologise to Nigel Farage.Polanski told the BBC’s Newsnight programme he had accepted a request to collaborate with a photographer on Instagram, with the first photo in a set of 20 showing himself, and the fifth showing the T-shirt.
